hypothesis: Increasing both the primary and fresh-confirmation panels from 512 to 800 hidden worlds reduces decision noise enough to improve the maintained full actor without widening its top-policy shortlist or changing its continuation method.

dependency_and_selection_rule.rule: If and only if the completed role-coherent holdout has authoritative promotion_gate_passed=true after hardened raw-input revalidation, compare 800+800 against the role-coherent 512+512 actor. If it validly fails, compare 800+800 against the unchanged mode-2/prefix-2 actor. If the parent is operationally invalid or incomplete, do not start this test.

only_intended_changes: primary hidden-world count dets changes from 512 to 800
fresh trusted-prefix confirmation count confirm_dets changes from 512 to 800
unchanged: champion checkpoint and all policy/value outputs
root and continuation suit group selected by the parent-test rule
top-five, two-percent policy shortlist and all practical/evidence gates
ply-14 phase boundary, uniform hidden-world sampling, objective mode 0, and exact one-card terminal solution
discard guards, semantic/draw variants, planners, recursive replan, and bounded late resolver remain disabled
candidate_definition.candidate_width: Only the existing top-policy prefix is evaluated; no additional legal move is admitted.
why_800: 800 is two complete 20x20 ordered role-mapping periods if role coherence is selected
800 is divisible by the 20-way continuation group if mode 2 remains selected
704 would duplicate only 304 of 400 ordered role mappings in its partial second period
batch_dets remains zero, so there is no 64-world implementation boundary to prefer 704
deck-two support still caps at 90 assignments, while deck-three can use up to 800 of 990 assignments
candidate_definition.compute_interpretation: The independently verified inference shortcut is about 1.44x faster with byte-identical decisions. Eight hundred worlds is 1.5625x the panel size, deliberately reinvesting essentially all of that saving plus a small additional budget into lower Monte Carlo error.

source.compiler: gcc on one pinned ubuntu-24.04 build runner
source.single_binary_requirement: Build and hash one evaluator once, then distribute that exact artifact to every shard.
source.runtime_provenance_requirement: Every raw shard must bind this plan SHA-256, the selected parent-result SHA-256, source commit, arena/model hashes, threads=4, exact actors, seed, pair range, and rounds.

prior_evidence.status: No retained 800+800 versus 512+512 strength A/B exists. Runtime speedups and sampling-variance arguments select the fixed candidate but are not efficacy evidence.
excluded_from_gate: all root-120, role-coherent, policy-only, viewer, position-probe, performance, and historical world-count results
any operational smoke performed after this plan is committed

locked_actor_test.purpose: This fresh reciprocal full-actor test alone can promote the selected 800+800 candidate.
locked_actor_test.inspection_rule: Do not inspect or publish any efficacy result until all 50 shards complete, every raw sidecar hash passes, and the hardened reciprocal merge succeeds.
locked_actor_test.combination: Invert block two to the candidate perspective, then equal-weight the two independent reciprocal blocks. Combined SE is sqrt(SE1^2 + SE2^2) / 2.
promotion_gate: combined candidate match score minus 1.645 pair-clustered standard errors exceeds 0.5
candidate match-score point estimate exceeds 0.5 in each reciprocal orientation
all recorded raw shards reopen, hash, and exactly remerge to the submitted summaries
zero cap-terminated rounds, incomplete shards, gaps, overlaps, malformed rows, provenance mismatches, or operational errors

power_note: Using the completed root-120 actor panel only as a variance calibration, 5000 total pairs should yield about 0.41 percentage-point match-score SE. The expected one-sided boundary is near 50.68%, with roughly 78% power for a true +1 percentage-point gain and 98% for +1.5 points.
claim_limits: This jointly tests the deployable primary-plus-confirmation world increase and cannot attribute a gain to either panel separately.
A failed gate means not promoted; it does not establish equality or inferiority unless the reported confidence interval supports that narrower statement.
The test compares strength, not equal wall time. Exact timings are reported and no world count is reduced to equalize compute.
Exploratory, parent-test, operational, policy-only, or position-review observations are never pooled into this estimate.
reporting: Report each orientation and the equal-weight candidate result: match score and pair-clustered SE, point margin and SE, W/L/D, cap count, total pairs, elapsed time, model/arena/source/plan/parent-result hashes, compiler, and exact actor specifications.
Retain every integer pair row, timing sidecar, evaluator build record, and canonical merged-row SHA-256.
Report the selected continuation family and the authoritative parent artifact that mechanically selected it.
